config.label: Total Agency
config.sql_query:
WITH trans_agency AS (
    SELECT
        ff.id,
        ff.description,
        ff.metadata['transaction_date'] AS transaction_date,
        ff.metadata['value_date'] AS value_date,
        -ff.amount AS amount,
        ff.is_duplicate_parent_reference
        FROM {env}_recon_data_catalog_db.{env}_recon_data_transaction_other_ew1 ff
        WHERE ff.account_id = %(tp_account_id)s

        AND ff.client_id = %(client_id)s

)

-- CTE 1: Get individual entries from the Entries Report
WITH individual_entries AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(ff.transaction_date AS DATE) AS entry_date,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN regexp_like(lower(ff.metadata['source_file_name']), 'agency_banking_report|ag|other_transfers_report')
                    AND lower(ff.metadata['settlement_impact_desc']) = 'amount_payable' THEN 
                    ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ff.metadata['tran_amount_rsp'] AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0.00))

                WHEN regexp_like(lower(ff.metadata['source_file_name']), 'billpayment_report')
                    AND NOT ff.is_duplicate THEN 
                    ABS(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ff.metadata['tran_amount_rsp'] AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0.00))

                WHEN regexp_like(lower(ff.metadata['source_file_name']), 'atm_withdrawal_report')
                    AND lower(ff.metadata['settlement_impact_desc']) = 'amount_payable' THEN 
                    ABS(
                        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ff.metadata['surcharge'] AS DECIMAL(18, 4)), 0) + 
                        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ff.metadata['amount_impact'] AS DECIMAL(18, 4)), 0)
                    )

                WHEN regexp_like(lower(ff.metadata['source_file_name']), 'atm_transfers_report|qt_transfers_report')
                    AND lower(ff.metadata['settlement_impact_desc']) = 'amount_payable' THEN 
                    ABS(
                        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ff.metadata['tran_amount_rsp'] AS DECIMAL(18, 2)), 0.00) + 
                        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ff.metadata['surcharge'] AS DECIMAL(8, 2)), 0.00)
                    )

                ELSE 0
            END AS DECIMAL(18, 4)
        ) AS entry_amount
    FROM {env}_recon_data_catalog_db.{env}_recon_data_transaction_other_ew1 ff
    WHERE ff.client_id = %(client_id)s
      AND ff.account_id = %(tp_account_id)s
      AND DATE(ff.value_date) >= DATE_ADD('day', -4, DATE(%(end_date)s))
      AND DATE(ff.value_date) < DATE(%(end_date)s)
),

-- CTE 2: Extract GL postings with settlement dates MINUS 1 DAY
gl_postings AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(ff.transaction_date AS DATE) AS gl_posting_date,
        ABS(ff.amount) AS gl_cleared_amount,
        ff.description AS gl_narration,
       DATE_ADD(
        'day', 
        -1, 
        TRY_CAST(
            CONCAT(
                -- Extract year (handles both 2-digit & 4-digit)
                CASE 
                    WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(ff.description, '(?i)(\d{{1,2}}\.[a-z]{{3}}\.\d{{2,4}})')) = 10 
                        THEN CONCAT('20', SUBSTR(REGEXP_EXTRACT(ff.description, '(?i)(\d{{1,2}}\.[a-z]{{3}}\.\d{{2,4}})'), 8, 2)) 
                    ELSE SUBSTR(REGEXP_EXTRACT(ff.description, '(?i)(\d{{1,2}}\.[a-z]{{3}}\.\d{{2,4}})'), 8, 4)
                END,
                '-',
                CASE LOWER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_EXTRACT(ff.description, '(?i)(\d{{1,2}}\.[a-z]{{3}}\.\d{{2,4}})'), 4, 3))
                    WHEN 'jan' THEN '01' WHEN 'feb' THEN '02' WHEN 'mar' THEN '03'
                    WHEN 'apr' THEN '04' WHEN 'may' THEN '05' WHEN 'jun' THEN '06'
                    WHEN 'jul' THEN '07' WHEN 'aug' THEN '08' WHEN 'sep' THEN '09'
                    WHEN 'oct' THEN '10' WHEN 'nov' THEN '11' WHEN 'dec' THEN '12'
                END,
                '-',
                SUBSTR(REGEXP_EXTRACT(ff.description, '(?i)(\d{{1,2}}\.[a-z]{{3}}\.\d{{2,4}})'), 1, 2)
            ) AS DATE
        )
    ) AS settlement_date_adjusted
    FROM {env}_recon_data_catalog_db.{env}_recon_data_transaction_backend_ew1 ff
    WHERE ff.client_id = %(client_id)s
      AND ff.account_id = %(account_id)s
      AND DATE(ff.transaction_date) >= DATE_ADD('day', -4, DATE(%(end_date)s))
      AND DATE(ff.transaction_date) <= DATE(%(end_date)s)
      AND ff.reporting_tag = 'kuda_settlement'
      AND ff.transaction_type = 'D'
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(ff.description, '(?i)kuda[^a-zA-Z]?verve[^a-zA-Z]?card[^a-zA-Z]?sett')
),

-- CTE 3: Aggregate entries by date
daily_entries AS (
    SELECT
        entry_date,
        SUM(entry_amount) AS total_entries_amount,
        COUNT(entry_amount) AS num_entries
    FROM individual_entries
    GROUP BY entry_date
),

-- CTE 4: Aggregate GL postings by ADJUSTED settlement date
daily_cleared AS (
    SELECT
        settlement_date_adjusted AS entry_date,  -- Using the adjusted date
        SUM(gl_cleared_amount) AS total_cleared_amount,
        COUNT(gl_cleared_amount) AS num_postings,
        MAX(gl_narration) AS sample_narration,
        MIN(gl_posting_date) AS earliest_posting_date,
        MAX(gl_posting_date) AS latest_posting_date
    FROM gl_postings
    WHERE settlement_date_adjusted IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY settlement_date_adjusted
),

-- CTE 5: Combine entries with their corresponding GL postings
reconciliation_data AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(de.entry_date, dc.entry_date) AS entry_date,
        COALESCE(de.total_entries_amount, 0) AS entries_amount,
        COALESCE(de.num_entries, 0) AS num_entries,
        COALESCE(dc.total_cleared_amount, 0) AS cleared_amount,
        COALESCE(dc.num_postings, 0) AS num_postings,
        dc.sample_narration,
        dc.earliest_posting_date,
        dc.latest_posting_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN de.entry_date IS NOT NULL AND dc.entry_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Fully Posted'
            WHEN de.entry_date IS NOT NULL AND dc.entry_date IS NULL THEN 'Unposted'
            WHEN de.entry_date IS NULL AND dc.entry_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Over-cleared'
            ELSE 'No Activity'
        END AS posting_status,
        -- Exact match check
        CASE 
            WHEN de.total_entries_amount = dc.total_cleared_amount THEN 'Exact Match'
            WHEN de.total_entries_amount > 0 AND dc.total_cleared_amount > 0 AND de.total_entries_amount != dc.total_cleared_amount THEN 'Amount Mismatch'
            WHEN de.total_entries_amount > 0 AND dc.total_cleared_amount = 0 THEN 'Not Posted'
            WHEN de.total_entries_amount = 0 AND dc.total_cleared_amount > 0 THEN 'Over-posted'
            ELSE 'No Activity'
        END AS reconciliation_status
    FROM daily_entries de
    FULL OUTER JOIN daily_cleared dc ON de.entry_date = dc.entry_date
    WHERE COALESCE(de.entry_date, dc.entry_date) IS NOT NULL
),

result as (
    -- Final SELECT with settlement date focus and ascending cumulative order
    SELECT
        entry_date AS settlement_date,
        entries_amount AS settlement_entries_amount,
        cleared_amount AS gl_posted_amount,
               sample_narration AS gl_narration,
         latest_posting_date as Gl_posting_date,
               (entries_amount - cleared_amount) AS daily_difference,
        SUM(entries_amount - cleared_amount) OVER (
            ORDER BY entry_date ASC
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS cumulative_difference
    FROM reconciliation_data
    ORDER BY entry_date ASC -- Changed to ASC to see cumulative clear out

)

MERGE INTO "{env}_recon_data_catalog_db"."{env}_recon_data_closing_balance_backend_ew1" AS r
USING (
    WITH calculated_closing_balance as (
        SELECT
        COALESCE(({calculated_balance_proof_sum}), 0) as calculated_closing_balance_amount
    ),
    end_date_balance AS (
        SELECT
            client_id,
            account_id,
            balance_date,
            balance
        FROM "{env}_recon_data_catalog_db"."{env}_recon_data_closing_balance_backend_ew1"
        WHERE client_id = %(client_id)s
            AND account_id = %(account_id)s
            AND CAST(balance_date AS DATE) = date_parse(%(end_date)s, '%%Y-%%m-%%d')--end date
        ORDER BY DATE(balance_date) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ),
    updated_balance AS (
        SELECT
            %(client_id)s AS client_id,
            %(account_id)s AS account_id,
            date_parse(%(end_date)s, '%%Y-%%m-%%d') AS balance_date, -- end date
            CASE
                WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM end_date_balance)
                THEN (SELECT calculated_closing_balance_amount FROM calculated_closing_balance)
                ELSE ((SELECT calculated_closing_balance_amount FROM calculated_closing_balance) ) -- Fallback balance value
            END AS balance
    )
    SELECT
        client_id,
        account_id,
        balance_date,
        balance
    FROM
    updated_balance

ON cast(r.client_id AS integer) = t.client_id
  AND cast(r.account_id AS integer) = t.account_id
  AND DATE_FORMAT(r.balance_date, '%%Y-%%m-%%d') = DATE_FORMAT(t.balance_date, '%%Y-%%m-%%d')
